title: Convert win/loss chart to bar graph and fix best streak calculation

requirements.text: Convert the ProfileWinLossChart component from a line chart to a bar chart using Recharts. Replace the LineChart and Line components with BarChart and Bar components, keeping all existing filters (week, month, year, all-time), axis labels, tooltips, and color conventions (wins vs losses) intact.

quotes: I think this might be better as a bar graph however
Convert the line graph to a bar chart

acceptanceCriteria: The win/loss chart in ProfileWinLossChart.tsx renders as a bar chart instead of a line chart
Both wins and losses are represented as grouped or stacked bars
All existing time range filters (week, month, year, all-time) continue to work correctly
Axis labels, tooltips, and legend remain functional and visually consistent

requirements.text: Fix the best streak calculation displayed in the profile page's win/loss streaks section. The current implementation incorrectly uses a cumulative total instead of finding the longest consecutive streak of wins. Rewrite the logic to iterate through match history in chronological order and track the maximum number of consecutive days (or consecutive entries) with a win, storing the highest streak count reached.

quotes: best streak section in profile is not correct
It uses a cumulative total instead of actual streak
Fix the best streak calculation in the profile section so it tracks the longest consecutive streak rather than a cumulative total

acceptanceCriteria: The best streak value shown in the profile section reflects the longest consecutive winning streak, not a cumulative total
If a player has non-consecutive wins, only the longest unbroken run is counted
A player with zero wins shows a best streak of 0
The value updates correctly when new match history data is loaded

constraints: Do not change the backend schema or any backend logic
Do not modify files listed in frontend.immutablePaths
nonGoals: Adding new chart types beyond the bar chart conversion
Changing the current streak calculation (only best streak is affected)
Modifying the match history data fetching logic
